title: Buchu Pie with Chive Crust
description: A savory pie filled with the flavors of South Africa, combining the earthy taste of buchu with the richness of velvety ingredients.
instructions: Roll out the pie crust and place in a 9-inch pie dish.
In a skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped buchu leaves and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the crumbled velvety cheese and cook until melted and smooth. Stir in the xgarlicky sauce.
Pour the cheese mixture into the pie crust.
Sprinkle the chopped chives over the top of the pie.
Bake the pie for 25-30 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is heated through.
Remove the pie from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
